blocks.text: Borrowed gravity gives the pet several competing senses of down.
Location: The Room of Borrowed Gravity
Appearance: Separate grains accelerate toward four competing directions of down and settle against temporary ledges.
Care: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
Story connection: A future room puzzle could return a borrowed direction to its owner.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.
